subject.title: Add optional `name`/`label` field to group config entries

question: Should OpenClaw standardize an inert `label` field across channel group-entry configs while preserving existing functional `name` semantics?
rationale: This adds public config surface across multiple channel owners, and the proposed `name` alternative is ambiguous beside existing account names and dangerous runtime name matching.

options.title: Add inert `label`
options.body: Adopt one optional ignored `label` string across the explicitly defined group-entry types, schemas, generated metadata, tests, and docs.

options.title: Standardize `name`
options.body: Use `name` only after auditing and reconciling every existing display-name and runtime name-matching use across channels.

options.title: Keep behavior-only entries
options.body: Decline embedded metadata and continue relying on external operator documentation to map identifiers to recognizable groups.

recommendation.title: Add inert `label`
recommendation.body: Adopt one optional ignored `label` string across the explicitly defined group-entry types, schemas, generated metadata, tests, and docs.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the broadest recent history across the shared config-schema and group-documentation surfaces and already participated in the issue's contract review.
